sections.content: PWAs turn websites into app-like experiences: installable icons, offline support via service workers, push notifications, and fast repeat loads.
Requirements: HTTPS, a web app manifest (name, icons, theme), and a service worker for caching. The manifest JSON declares installability.
Key points: service workers intercept network requests, Lighthouse audits PWA criteria, and iOS support lags behind Chrome/Android.
Try this variation — change a value, predict the output, then run it:

  "name": "My App",
  "short_name": "App",

}
